story: Apple explores robotics in search of life beyond the iPhone
text: Very few companies survive Robotics projects, as the public has decades of unrealistic expectations from entertainment media. If the plan is an unconstrained general purpose use-case design, than the reality of the processing power needed to do simple tasks will quickly hit the product. If the board is serious, than just purchase the universal-robots.com company. Then add whatever branding and software you thought was useful on top of the existing platform. Making a profitable Robotics company is hard, as they are not generally a consumer product. I'd try Apple branded appliances, and you know people would buy a talking toaster: [VIDEO] Best of luck =)
The toaster mention reminded me of this: [VIDEO] This is how "talking to AI" feels like for anything mildly complex.
